candidates.violated_requirement: Gray-to-binary conversion should use XOR operations between adjacent bits. Using AND instead breaks the conversion, causing incorrect binary values and subsequent Gray code outputs to differ from expected sequence.
candidates.spec_basis: The specification requires converting Gray code to binary using XOR operations between adjacent bits (step 2 of the process)

candidates.violated_requirement: Gray-to-binary conversion requires XOR operations between adjacent bits. Using OR operation instead will produce incorrect binary values, leading to wrong Gray code outputs that don't follow the single-bit change sequence.
candidates.spec_basis: The specification requires converting Gray code to binary using XOR operations between adjacent bits (step 2 of the process)

candidates.violated_requirement: Binary-to-Gray conversion should use XOR between the binary value and its right-shifted version. Using AND instead breaks the conversion, causing the output Gray code to not follow the single-bit change sequence.
candidates.spec_basis: The specification requires converting binary back to Gray code using XOR between the binary value and its right-shifted version (step 4 of the process)
